versions.content: function  Can_SetControllerMode  [SWS_CP_CAN_00003]   Std_ReturnType Can_SetControllerMode(uint8 Controller, Can_ControllerStateType Transition); Transitions controller states between STOPPED, STARTED, and SLEEP.
